java.say: Each promotion is a DiscountRule: it says how much discount an order gets.
CashRegister has a list of rules. It does not know which promotions they are.
It asks each rule for its discount and subtracts it.
A new promotion is a new class.
For every 3 of a product, 1 is free.
The free items are the discount. CashRegister and the other rules did not change: open for extension, closed for change.
